title: LUMA: Benchmarking Segmentation via a Lightweight Universal Mask Adapter
abstract: arXiv:2607.00687v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Comparing transformer backbones for image segmentation is confounded: each is paired with a different decoder, recipe, and pretraining, so reported differences rarely reflect the backbone itself. We introduce the Lightweight Universal Mask Adapter (LUMA), a lightweight, backbone-agnostic mask-transformer head that treats any backbone as a black-box feature extractor, letting a set of queries read from its features through cheap cross-attention. LUMA matches the accuracy of EoMT, the state-of-the-art efficient ViT-segmenter, at cost parity, while attaching unchanged to hierarchical, convolutional, and mixture-of-experts backbones alike. Holding this head fixed, we benchmark 20 backbones, 11 pretraining schemes and a range of resolutions on ADE20K, COCO, and Cityscapes under one modern recipe. We find that ``efficient'' token mixers fail to deliver efficiency even at the high resolutions that motivate them, with plain ViT holding

translated_title: LUMA：通过轻量级通用掩码适配器进行分割基准测试
translated_abstract: 比较用于图像分割的transformer骨干网络存在混淆因素：每个骨干网络都搭配不同的解码器、训练配方和预训练方案，因此报告的性能差异很少能反映骨干网络本身。我们提出了轻量级通用掩码适配器（LUMA），这是一种轻量级、与骨干网络无关的掩码transformer头，它将任何骨干网络视为黑盒特征提取器，让一组查询通过低成本的交叉注意力从其特征中读取信息。LUMA在成本相当的情况下达到了EoMT（最先进的高效ViT分割器）的精度，同时无需修改即可附加到分层、卷积和混合专家骨干网络上。在保持该头固定不变的情况下，我们在统一的现代训练配方下，在ADE20K、COCO和Cityscapes数据集上对20个骨干网络、11种预训练方案以及一系列分辨率进行了基准测试。我们发现“高效”的token混合器即使在激发其设计初衷的高分辨率下也未能提供效率优势，而普通ViT保持……
tldr: LUMA提出了一种轻量级、与骨干网络无关的掩码适配器头，在成本相当的情况下匹配最先进方法的精度，并在统一配方下对20个骨干网络和11种预训练方案进行了系统基准测试，发现普通ViT优于各类“高效”架构。
en_tdlr: LUMA is a lightweight, backbone-agnostic mask adapter head that matches state-of-the-art accuracy at cost parity and enables unified benchmarking of 20 backbones and 11 pretraining schemes, revealing that plain ViT outperforms "efficient" token mixers even at high resolutions.
